say:2:1120301001:0.text: Are you alright? You're not hurt, are you?
say:2:1120301001:0.source_cn: 还好吗？你还有哪里不舒服？

say:4:1120301003:0.text: It hurts so much, Alsa. My body's aching all over...
say:4:1120301003:0.source_cn: 阿尔萨姐姐，我好难受，感觉浑身都很疼……

say:5:1120301004:0.text: Just hang in there, okay? You're the bravest little boy in the world, remember?
say:5:1120301004:0.source_cn: 再坚持一下。我们之前说过，你是最勇敢的孩子，对吧？

say:6:1120301005:0.text: You'll feel better soon enough, trust me.
say:6:1120301005:0.source_cn: 你一定会好起来的，相信我。

choice_prompt:7:1120301005.text: You'll feel better soon enough, trust me.
choice_prompt:7:1120301005.source_cn: 你一定会好起来的，相信我。

say:8:1120301006:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... This boy is very sick.
say:8:1120301006:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... This boy is very sick.
say:8:1120301006:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... This boy is very sick.

say:9:1120301007:0.text: At first, I thought it was just a common cold, but it just kept worsening. He's been burning up with a high fever all this time as well...
say:9:1120301007:0.source_cn: 本来以为只是普通的着凉，没想到现在越来越严重，而且持续...

say:15:1120301009:1.text: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?
say:15:1120301009:1.source_cn: 用药的话……主人，你有什么好建议吗？
say:15:1120301009:1.male: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?
say:15:1120301009:1.female: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?

choice_prompt:16:1120301009.text: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?
choice_prompt:16:1120301009.source_cn: 用药的话……主人，你有什么好建议吗？
choice_prompt:16:1120301009.male: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?
choice_prompt:16:1120301009.female: Medicine, huh... What would you prescribe for this, Magister?

say:17:1120301010:1.text: Don't worry, I'm somewhat familiar with them.

say:18:1120301011:1.text: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.
say:18:1120301011:1.male: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.
say:18:1120301011:1.female: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.

choice_prompt:19:1120301011.text: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.
choice_prompt:19:1120301011.male: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.
choice_prompt:19:1120301011.female: Forgive me, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... But I need to go find some herbs.

say:21:1120301012:0.text: Magister's right! We can find those herbs more quickly if we work together!
say:21:1120301012:0.source_cn: 主人说得对。多一个帮手，就能快点找到草药！
say:21:1120301012:0.male: Magister's right! We can find those herbs more quickly if we work together!
say:21:1120301012:0.female: Magister's right! We can find those herbs more quickly if we work together!

say:22:1120301013:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Thank you all so much!
say:22:1120301013:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Thank you all so much!
say:22:1120301013:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>... Thank you all so much!

choice:16:0:1.text: I don't know enough about his illness.
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 现在信息不足，无法判断
choice:16:0:1.male: I don't know enough about his illness.
choice:16:0:1.female: I don't know enough about his illness.

choice:16:1:2.text: I don't know about Mauler remedies.
choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 我不太了解蛮血的草药
choice:16:1:2.male: I don't know about Mauler remedies.
choice:16:1:2.female: I don't know about Mauler remedies.

say:0:1120302001:0.text: These are the beasthoof herbs we need.
say:0:1120302001:0.source_cn: 这些就是我们要找的兽蹄草了。

say:1:1120302002:0.text: This should be more than enough for our needs.
say:1:1120302002:0.source_cn: 嗯，采了这么多，应该够用了。

say:2:1120302003:0.text: Wait for me, Karun... I promise I will cure you.
say:2:1120302003:0.source_cn: ……卡鲁恩，等着我，我一定会治好你的。

say:0:1120303001:0.text: According to Pops, if I mix it clockwise three times, then counterclockwise five more times...
say:0:1120303001:0.source_cn: 按照老爹教的办法，顺时针转3圈，再逆时针转5圈……

say:0:1120304001:0.text: There, that should do it! Now I just have to give it to Karun!
say:0:1120304001:0.source_cn: 成了！得快点去喂给卡鲁恩！

say:3:1120305001:0.text: I'm sorry, Alsa... *Cough* But I'm still...*Cough*
say:3:1120305001:0.source_cn: 对不起，阿尔萨，咳咳，姐姐……我还是……咳咳！

say:4:1120305002:0.source_cn: 明明已经吃了药，为什么病情还是没有好转……

say:5:1120305003:1.text: Maybe it just needs more time to take effect?
say:5:1120305003:1.source_cn: 呃，难道是还没到起效的时间？

say:8:1120305004:1.text: Don't be silly, Chippy! It should've started working by now!
say:8:1120305004:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，药都喝了这么久了，早就该起作用了！

say:9:1120305005:0.text: What should I do? Aside from this herb... I don't know how else to treat him...
say:9:1120305005:0.source_cn: 怎么办……除了这种草药，我不知道其他治疗的办法了……

say:10:1120305006:0.text: It's all my fault! If only I had noticed the problem sooner... I'm so sorry, Karun...
say:10:1120305006:0.source_cn: 都怪我，如果我早点发现问题就好了……都是我的错……

choice_prompt:11:1120305006.text: It's all my fault! If only I had noticed the problem sooner... I'm so sorry, Karun...
choice_prompt:11:1120305006.source_cn: 都怪我，如果我早点发现问题就好了……都是我的错……

say:12:1120305007:1.text: You're right, panicking won't solve anything... My stress got the better of me just now. Sorry.
say:12:1120305007:1.source_cn: 你说得对，我现在着急也没有用……抱歉，是我急昏头了。

say:13:1120305008:1.text: I know how you feel! We were just as anxious when you were stabbed with that poisoned dagger and passed out!
say:13:1120305008:1.source_cn: 没关系！之前阿尔萨被毒匕首刺伤晕倒的时候，大家也是这么...

say:14:1120305009:1.text: Poisoned dagger... and me passing out...

say:15:1120305010:1.text: Come to think of it, who healed me back at the Warsong Festival?
say:15:1120305010:1.source_cn: 说起来，之前我在战歌节上受伤的那次，是谁把我治好的？

say:18:1120305011:1.text: Smokey did! That meerkat really knows how to mix his herbs!
say:18:1120305011:1.source_cn: 那只叫阿熏的狐獴。他好像很擅长制药。

say:19:1120305012:1.text: If he's really that talented, I wonder if he can heal Karun as well...?
say:19:1120305012:1.source_cn: 如果他真的这么厉害的话，不知道能不能帮帮这孩子……

choice_prompt:20:1120305012.text: If he's really that talented, I wonder if he can heal Karun as well...?
choice_prompt:20:1120305012.source_cn: 如果他真的这么厉害的话，不知道能不能帮帮这孩子……

say:22:1120305015:1.text: Then... Do you know where we can find Smokey?
say:22:1120305015:1.source_cn: 唔……可是，我们现在要去哪里找到这位阿熏呢？

say:23:1120305016:1.text: If I remember correctly, Mikola was the one who brought him to the Warsong Festival. We should ask her first.
say:23:1120305016:1.source_cn: 我记得之前在战歌节上，是曼卡拉把他带过来的。我们可以找...

say:24:1120305017:1.text: Then let's go. We can't waste any more time!
say:24:1120305017:1.source_cn: 好。这孩子的病情应该也不能再耽误了。

say:27:1120305018:0.text: *Cough* A-Alsa... Where are you all going...?
say:27:1120305018:0.source_cn: 咳、咳咳……呜……阿尔萨姐姐，你们要去哪里……

say:28:1120305019:0.text: We're going out to find you even better medicine. Once we bring it back, you'll feel better in no time.
say:28:1120305019:0.source_cn: 乖孩子，我们要去帮你找药。吃下那种药，你就会好起来的。

say:29:1120305020:0.text: That's why, no matter how uncomfortable it gets, you have to hang on until we get back. Understand?
say:29:1120305020:0.source_cn: 所以在我们回来之前，不管多难受你都要坚持住，好吗？

say:30:1120305021:1.text: I'll make sure the others take good care of you until we return.
say:30:1120305021:1.source_cn: 我会拜托其他人好好照顾你的。

say:31:1120305022:0.text: O-Okay! *Cough* I'll do exactly what you say, Alsa. Come back soon, okay?
say:31:1120305022:0.source_cn: 好！咳，咳……我相信阿尔萨姐姐！我会乖乖等你们回来的！

say:32:1120305023:1.text: ...He won't last much longer in his condition.
say:32:1120305023:1.source_cn: ……这孩子的情况，应该不能再拖了。

say:33:1120305024:1.text: I know, which is why we need to go to the arena and find Mikola right away!
say:33:1120305024:1.source_cn: 嗯。事不宜迟，我们赶紧去武斗场找曼卡拉吧！

say:35:1120305014:1.text: We don't have the luxury of time right now. Let's just ask Smokey and see where that leads.
say:35:1120305014:1.source_cn: 我们现在时间紧张，可以先试试阿熏这条线索。

choice:20:1:2.text: We should think of something else.
choice:20:1:2.male: We should think of something else.
choice:20:1:2.female: We should think of something else.

choice:11:1:2.text: Let's find another way to treat him.
choice:11:1:2.male: Let's find another way to treat him.
choice:11:1:2.female: Let's find another way to treat him.

say:3:1120306001:1.text: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...
say:3:1120306001:1.source_cn: 啊呀，乌尔氏族的年轻勇者们，还有这位厉害的魔法师……
say:3:1120306001:1.male: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...
say:3:1120306001:1.female: What's going on? A powerful mage, accompanied by some young Uru Clan warriors...

say:4:1120306002:1.text: What brings you to my arena today?
say:4:1120306002:1.source_cn: 是什么风把你们给吹来了？

say:5:1120306003:1.text: We're looking for your meerkat friend, Mikola. It's urgent, so can you help us?
say:5:1120306003:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉，我们有急事要找狐獴。你能帮帮我们吗？

say:6:1120306004:1.text: More specifically, the one who sold illicit potions before saving Alsa.
say:6:1120306004:1.source_cn: 就是之前贩卖非法药剂，后来又救了阿尔萨那位。

say:7:1120306005:1.text: ...So you're looking for Smokey, eh? Sorry, but I promised that I wouldn't disclose his location without his consent.
say:7:1120306005:1.source_cn: ……你们想要找阿熏啊。但很可惜，我答应过他，不会擅自透...

say:8:1120306006:1.text: As you all know, Smokey's made no shortage of enemies in his life. Plenty of people would love to get revenge on him for his past deeds.
say:8:1120306006:1.source_cn: 你们知道的，阿熏曾经做过一些不好的勾当，多多少少有些仇人。

say:9:1120306007:1.text: His own safety is his highest concern... So I can't tell you where he is right now. Sorry.
say:9:1120306007:1.source_cn: 他很在意自己的安全……所以很抱歉，我不能告诉你们他的藏身地。

say:10:1120306008:1.text: I swear, Mikola, we're only looking for him because we desperately need his help. We won't share his whereabouts with anyone else!
say:10:1120306008:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉，我发誓，我们找他真的只是想要寻求帮助，而且我们...

say:11:1120306009:1.text: A young Mauler in the Uru Clan is gravely ill, and none of the herbs I've tried have worked on him.
say:11:1120306009:1.source_cn: 乌尔氏族有个小蛮血生了重病，我试了所有的草药，都没有用处。

say:12:1120306010:1.text: Since Smokey saved me from that dagger's poison back at the Warsong Festival, I thought he might be able to save this little boy too...
say:12:1120306010:1.source_cn: 听说之前我被毒匕首刺伤那次就是阿熏救了我。我想，应该只...

choice_prompt:13:1120306010.text: Since Smokey saved me from that dagger's poison back at the Warsong Festival, I thought he might be able to save this little boy too...
choice_prompt:13:1120306010.source_cn: 听说之前我被毒匕首刺伤那次就是阿熏救了我。我想，应该只有他能治好那孩子了……

say:14:1120306011:1.text: Fine, I'll make an exception for you since it's an emergency. After all, you're the victors of the Warsong Festival...
say:14:1120306011:1.source_cn: ……好吧，既然话都说到这份上了，你们又是战歌节的胜利者……

say:16:1120306013:1.text: I'll give you Smokey's location, but only under one condition—
say:16:1120306013:1.source_cn: 我会把阿熏的地址告诉你们。但有一个条件——

say:17:1120306014:1.text: If you do manage to find him, he can't know that I was the one who gave up his secret. He's the type to hold a grudge for a very long time.
say:17:1120306014:1.source_cn: 如果你们成功找到阿熏的话，不要和他说地址是我透露的。那...

say:18:1120306015:1.text: Thanks, Mikola! And don't worry, we'll keep our lips sealed for sure!
say:18:1120306015:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，曼卡拉！我们一定会守口如瓶的！

say:19:1120306016:1.text: Don't mention it, but like I said, that meerkat takes his own safety more seriously than anything else...
say:19:1120306016:1.source_cn: 不客气。不过，就像我刚刚说的那样，阿熏是非常在意自身安...

say:20:1120306017:1.text: Even with his location in hand, finding Smokey will still be a challenge.
say:20:1120306017:1.source_cn: 所以即使有我给的地址，要找到他本人，你们应该还得费一番功夫。

choice:13:0:1.text: His life hangs in the balance.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 没错，事情关乎到一条性命
choice:13:0:1.male: His life hangs in the balance.
choice:13:0:1.female: His life hangs in the balance.

choice:13:1:2.text: We really need your help right now.
choice:13:1:2.male: We really need your help right now.
choice:13:1:2.female: We really need your help right now.

say:0:1120307001:0.text: So this is where Smokey is known to appear?
say:0:1120307001:0.source_cn: 阿熏就是在这附近出没吗？

say:2:1120307003:0.text: Chippy will try to sniff him out, too!
say:2:1120307003:0.source_cn: 满满也动用强大的嗅觉找找！

say:3:1120309001:1.text: For someone who was lying dead on the ground a second ago, you sure seem full of energy.
say:3:1120309001:1.source_cn: ……你这不是精神的很吗，刚刚还在地上装，现在马上就能跳...

say:4:1120309002:1.text: I was worried that something actually happened to you!
say:4:1120309002:1.source_cn: 就是！亏我还真以为你怎么了呢……

say:5:1120309003:0.text: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.
say:5:1120309003:0.source_cn: 啊呀，两位勇者大人，魔法师大人，小仓鼠大人，你们也都知...
say:5:1120309003:0.male: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.
say:5:1120309003:0.female: Well, as you all know by now, my line of work is not an easy one.

say:7:1120309004:1.text: Aside from woefully slim profits, I'm also under constant attack by revenge-seeking ruffians and the like. That's why it helps to have a few emergency escape tactics under my belt!
say:7:1120309004:1.source_cn: 不仅利润微薄，还容易结仇，动不动就被人喊打喊杀的。所以...

say:8:1120309005:1.text: Does it really count as "escaping" if you just lie on the ground like that?
say:8:1120309005:1.source_cn: ……就地躺倒这种方式，真的能让你“逃生”吗？

say:9:1120309006:1.text: You may not know it, but feigning death is a time-honored meerkat skill passed down from generation to generation... Eh, I've said too much.
say:9:1120309006:1.source_cn: 这你可就有所不知了，这招可是我们的传统技能……啊呀，不...

say:10:1120309007:1.text: So, what can I do for you, my friends?
say:10:1120309007:1.source_cn: 所以，各位大人们这次大驾光临，是有什么事情吗？

say:11:1120309008:1.text: We came to ask for your help.

choice_prompt:12:1120309008.text: We came to ask for your help.

say:13:1120309009:1.text: There's a very sick Mauler child who needs your help. At first, I thought he just had a cold, but his symptoms didn't stop worsening.
say:13:1120309009:1.source_cn: 是这样的，阿熏。我们族里有个孩子生病了，原本以为是普通...

say:14:1120309010:1.text: I gave him every herb I knew of in an attempt to cure him, but nothing worked at all. If anything, his condition is still deteriorating...
say:14:1120309010:1.source_cn: 我给她用了我知道的所有能缓解症状的草药，但是她却完全没...

say:15:1120309011:1.text: Just when we thought we were out of options, we remembered you... You're the one who saved my life back at the Warsong Festival!
say:15:1120309011:1.source_cn: 我们实在走投无路了，就想到了你……之前战歌节上，就是你...

say:16:1120309012:1.text: I've heard so much about your medical expertise and your potion-crafting skills... Would you please come back with us to the Uru Clan and treat this poor boy?
say:16:1120309012:1.source_cn: 听说你特别擅长制药，而且医术高超……求求你了，能不能和...

say:17:1120309013:1.text: So you want me to help with a sick child...
say:17:1120309013:1.source_cn: 原来你们来，是为了给孩子寻求帮助……

say:18:1120309014:1.text: *Sigh* I'm all too familiar with this sort of thing. After all, there are plenty of children in my family...
say:18:1120309014:1.source_cn: 唉，说到这个孩子，我可太清楚了。我家孩子也多得很……

say:19:1120309015:1.text: And taking care of even one of them is no easy feat. They can be so fragile sometimes... Oops, there I go rambling again!
say:19:1120309015:1.source_cn: 照顾孩子真不是一件容易事，动不动就冷了热了饿了……啊，...

say:20:1120309016:1.text: What I mean to say is that I'll gladly lend a hand! I just need to take a close look at the boy, and I'll know exactly what he needs.
say:20:1120309016:1.source_cn: 我其实是想说，你放心，这忙我一定帮！区区小病，我看几眼...

say:22:1120309018:1.text: But before that, please give me a moment. I still have some matters to discuss with Meerky.
say:22:1120309018:1.source_cn: 不过在那之前，还有劳各位稍等片刻。我有些事情要和蒙蒙交...

narration:28:1120326001:0.text: Smokey explains something to Meerky in great detail...
narration:28:1120326001:0.source_cn: 阿熏对着蒙蒙交代了一番……

say:3:1120310001:1.text: My business is all taken care of now. Sorry for the wait. If everyone's ready to leave, we can go at any time.
say:3:1120310001:1.source_cn: 久等了各位，我的事情已经交代好了。如果你们方便的话，我...

say:4:1120310002:1.text: The quicker we get there, the sooner this boy can start on the road to recovery, and everyone can put their minds at ease much earlier.
say:4:1120310002:1.source_cn: 早一点到达，那孩子的病情就可以早一点好转，你们也能早点...

say:5:1120310003:1.text: Every moment spent worrying about that child's health is agonizing for all of you, I'm sure.
say:5:1120310003:1.source_cn: 为孩子的安危提心吊胆的日子，可真不好过啊。

say:6:1120310004:1.text: I'm not sure I could ever thank you enough for this, Smokey...
say:6:1120310004:1.source_cn: 太好了！我简直不知道该怎么谢你才好……

say:7:1120310005:1.text: But if you manage to heal that boy, then, on behalf of the entire Uru Clan, Alsa and I swear we'll repay you in kind for your help.
say:7:1120310005:1.source_cn: 如果你真能治好那孩子，我和阿尔萨代表乌尔氏族向你承诺，...

say:8:1120310006:1.text: Oh come now, that won't be necessary! After all, the child's safety is what matters most right now...
say:8:1120310006:1.source_cn: 啊呀，好说好说！我帮你们，可不是为了酬劳，主要还是为了...

say:9:1120310007:1.text: But if you insist, I'll gladly accept any payment you and your companions are willing to offer!
say:9:1120310007:1.source_cn: 不过既然你们非要给，我也不会不收！到时候的酬劳就拜托各...

say:0:1120311001:0.text: What are they talking about, Soren?
say:0:1120311001:0.source_cn: 索恩，他们俩在说什么啊？

say:1:1120311002:0.text: I'm not sure... Must be some sort of meerkat language.
say:1:1120311002:0.source_cn: ……特殊的狐獴语言？完全听不懂。

say:2:1120311003:0.text: Glad I'm not the only one who doesn't understand...
say:2:1120311003:0.source_cn: 太好了，原来不止我听不懂……

say:0:1120312001:0.text: You settlement is blessed, I must say! No wonder they say great people thrive in great places!
say:0:1120312001:0.source_cn: 没想到，你们氏族的环境这么好！怪不得，人杰地灵啊！

say:1:1120312002:0.text: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!
say:1:1120312002:0.source_cn: 托梅林大人的福，我们这群小蛮血才能生存下来！
say:1:1120312002:0.male: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!
say:1:1120312002:0.female: All thanks to Magister Merlin's blessings, we Maulers can finally survive!

say:2:1120312003:0.text: Let's go check on the little Mauler.
say:2:1120312003:0.male: Let's go check on the little Mauler.
say:2:1120312003:0.female: Let's go check on the little Mauler.

say:2:1120313001:1.text: Strange... Did this boy run afoul of anyone recently? Perhaps another member of the clan?
say:2:1120313001:1.source_cn: 奇怪？这孩子最近有得罪过什么人吗？或者是有什么仇家之类的？

say:3:1120313002:1.text: I... I don't think so? Everyone in the Uru Clan gets along well with each other...
say:3:1120313002:1.source_cn: 没有……吧？在我们乌尔氏族，大家相处的都挺好的……

say:4:1120313003:1.text: Hmm... did he eat anything questionable in the last few days?
say:4:1120313003:1.source_cn: 嗯……那她这几天有没有吃什么乱七八糟的东西？

say:5:1120313004:1.text: I can't say for sure... After all, children randomly eat anything they pick up from the ground.
say:5:1120313004:1.source_cn: 这个……我不太确定。你知道的，小孩子经常容易把奇怪的东...

say:6:1120313005:1.text: Yes, you have a point. Meerky and the others eat anything they pick up when they're hungry. They even get so upset when I stop them...
say:6:1120313005:1.source_cn: 啊呀，说的也是，蒙蒙他们要是肚子饿了，什么都能往嘴里塞...

say:7:1120313006:1.text: Ahem, sorry about that! Now, my professional diagnosis is that this poor child's symptoms are the result of poisoning.
say:7:1120313006:1.source_cn: 咳，不好意思！总之根据我的经验来看，这孩子的症状应该都...

say:8:1120313007:1.text: P-Poisoning?! I knew it wasn't just a cold...
say:8:1120313007:1.source_cn: 中、中毒？！果然不是普通的生病嘛……

choice_prompt:9:1120313007.text: P-Poisoning?! I knew it wasn't just a cold...
choice_prompt:9:1120313007.source_cn: 中、中毒？！果然不是普通的生病嘛……

say:10:1120313008:1.text: I don't think so. After all, the Uru Clan is too distant from the other clans for them to easily poison the dwellers here.
say:10:1120313008:1.source_cn: 看着不像，毕竟乌尔氏族远离其他氏族，应该不会是有人蓄意投毒。

say:11:1120313010:1.text: T-then what should we do? Find whatever it is that made him sick? It's been so long though...
say:11:1120313010:1.source_cn: 那、那我们该怎么办？找到她之前吃的东西吗？但是已经过去...

say:12:1120313011:1.text: Don't worry. I've seen this type of poisoning before, and I know exactly how to treat it.
say:12:1120313011:1.source_cn: 放心，她中的毒我见过，而且也知道解药配方。

say:13:1120313012:1.text: Here you go! Just gather the herbs on this list, and I can whip up a remedy for him.
say:13:1120313012:1.source_cn: 喏，就是这个方子。你们只要按照方子上说的收集来草药就可以了。

say:14:1120313013:1.source_cn: 等等，这些草药好像有点眼熟……兽蹄草……

say:15:1120313014:1.text: I gave that to him before, but it didn't have any effect!
say:15:1120313014:1.source_cn: 兽蹄草我之前都给她用过！但是完全没有奏效……

say:16:1120313015:1.text: ...Well I have a secret formula that requires it!

say:18:1120313017:1.text: Now no more dilly-dallying! Just trust me and go!
say:18:1120313017:1.source_cn: 你就别管这么多了，相信我就行！

say:19:1120313018:1.text: After all, I saved you from your poisoning back at the Warsong Festival, remember?
say:19:1120313018:1.source_cn: 之前在战歌节上，你中的毒不也是我帮你解的嘛！

say:20:1120313019:1.text: On my honor, I, Smokey, will save this child so long as you bring me every one of those herbs!
say:20:1120313019:1.source_cn: 我阿熏在这里给你打包票，只要你们能给我找来这些药材，我...

say:21:1120313020:0.text: I'll watch over him, so get going for now!
say:21:1120313020:0.source_cn: 我先去照顾她了，你们快去快回！

say:26:1120313022:1.text: I agree, but right now... all we can do is trust him.
say:26:1120313022:1.source_cn: 嗯，我也这么觉得。但是现在……我们也只能相信他了。

say:27:1120313024:1.text: ...You two are right! I shouldn't get carried away with my thoughts.
say:27:1120313024:1.source_cn: ……你们说的没错！是我关心则乱了。

say:28:1120313025:1.text: Right now, we have to find more beasthoofs... Come with me, everyone!
say:28:1120313025:1.source_cn: 当务之急还是赶快找来兽蹄草……大家跟我来吧！

say:30:1120313023:1.text: As suspicious as he is, we really don't have much of a choice.
say:30:1120313023:1.source_cn: 虽然他很可疑，但我们也只有相信他了。

say:31:1120313009:1.source_cn: 不错，我也是这么推测的。

choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 是不是吃了不该吃的东西

say:0:1120314001:0.text: I know beasthoof gets its name from the wild animals that like to eat it...
say:0:1120314001:0.source_cn: ……虽说兽蹄草的名字的来源，与野兽喜欢吃它有关。

say:1:1120314002:0.text: But I didn't think we would run into so much trouble because of them.
say:1:1120314002:0.source_cn: 但这次的野兽，看起来也过于麻烦了一点。

say:2:1120314003:0.text: We don't have much of a choice. Let's go.

say:0:1120315001:0.text: Maybe we didn't gather enough last time? Let's just bring back a little more...
say:0:1120315001:0.source_cn: 这次，多采集点吧……是不是上次数量不够呢？

say:1:1120315002:0.text: Hmm... I suppose it's worth trying.

say:2:1120315003:0.text: That should do it. Let's head back.
say:2:1120315003:0.male: That should do it. Let's head back.
say:2:1120315003:0.female: That should do it. Let's head back.

say:2:1120316001:1.text: Is this enough for you, Smokey?
say:2:1120316001:1.source_cn: 阿熏，你看这些草药够吗？

say:3:1120316002:1.text: Let me see... Yep, that should do the trick!
say:3:1120316002:1.source_cn: 让我看看……嗯，应该差不多了。

say:4:1120316003:1.text: However, there's still one crucial step that can only be performed at my house. Which of you wants to come with me?
say:4:1120316003:1.source_cn: 不过，有个步骤必须得在我家制作，你们看看谁跟我过去？

say:5:1120316004:1.text: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...
say:5:1120316004:1.male: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...
say:5:1120316004:1.female: Soren, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you two go ahead. I'll stay here with Karun...

say:6:1120316005:1.text: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!
say:6:1120316005:1.source_cn: 卡鲁恩的情况很稳定了，只要再加上药剂，一定能恢复健康！
say:6:1120316005:1.male: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!
say:6:1120316005:1.female: Karun's condition is much more stable now. Once I administer the potion, he'll make a full recovery!

say:9:1120316006:1.text: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!
say:9:1120316006:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，不要太焦虑，我们很快回来！
say:9:1120316006:1.male: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!
say:9:1120316006:1.female: Don't worry, Alsa, we'll be back soon!

say:3:1120317001:1.text: Potion-crafting is a delicate art, that requires sophisticated and professional equipment in order to be performed properly.
say:3:1120317001:1.source_cn: 制药这种事，还是要到专业的地方，使用专业的设备才行。

say:4:1120317002:1.text: Naturally, my wonderful home is equipped with all of the necessary facilities!
say:4:1120317002:1.source_cn: 那当然就是在下家里的这些设备了。

say:5:1120317003:1.text: You're not talking about this rusty old cauldron, are you?
say:5:1120317003:1.source_cn: 你指的是面前的这口老旧的锅吗？

say:6:1120317004:1.text: Don't underestimate it! Every single scratch and stain is a testament to my achievements as an apothecary!
say:6:1120317004:1.source_cn: 不要小看它！这上面所有的痕迹，可都是成功药剂后留下的勋章啊。

say:7:1120317005:1.text: For a professional potion maker, your equipment doesn't seem especially professional. If anything, it all seems pretty crude...
say:7:1120317005:1.source_cn: 那你的专业制药设备，看起来有确实有些不专业，还很简陋。

say:8:1120317006:1.text: The word you're looking for is "minimalistic"! Besides, a cauldron doesn't need to do much more than serve as a container.
say:8:1120317006:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这怎么能叫简陋呢，只是比较简约罢了！而且锅这种东...

say:9:1120317007:1.text: I can't believe this guy just called his stuff "professional" a minute ago...
say:9:1120317007:1.source_cn: 这个家伙……明明刚刚还在说什么“专业的设备”……

say:10:1120317008:1.text: Alright, that's enough! This is the extract of all your hard-earned herbs, but that's not the end...
say:10:1120317008:1.source_cn: 安静安静，我要开始正式制药了。这些是你们刚刚好不容易摘...

say:12:1120317010:1.text: Don't just stand there! Come here and help me stir!

say:3:1120318001:1.text: There! Take this potion and give it to that little boy.
say:3:1120318001:1.source_cn: 好了。这瓶药剂，你们拿去给那孩子服下吧。

say:5:1120318003:1.text: It only took him a few minutes to make it... Magister, the longer we spend with this meerkat, the less reliable he seems...
say:5:1120318003:1.source_cn: 这才短短几分钟……竟然就已经做好了。主人，这只狐獴真的...
say:5:1120318003:1.male: It only took him a few minutes to make it... Magister, the longer we spend with this meerkat, the less reliable he seems...
say:5:1120318003:1.female: It only took him a few minutes to make it... Magister, the longer we spend with this meerkat, the less reliable he seems...

say:6:1120318004:1.source_cn: 他做的药剂真的有用吗？

choice_prompt:7:1120318004.source_cn: 他做的药剂真的有用吗？

say:8:1120318005:1.text: Alright, Smokey, let's go back to the Uru Clan now.
say:8:1120318005:1.source_cn: 阿熏，你和我们一起再回乌尔绿洲一次。

say:9:1120318006:1.text: I hardly think I need to come along, especially now that you have the potion in hand. Just give it to the sick Mauler boy, and everything will be fine.
say:9:1120318006:1.source_cn: 啊……我都已经把药剂给你们了，你们赶紧回去喂给那只中毒...

say:10:1120318007:1.text: After all, I wouldn't have much to do if I went back with you...
say:10:1120318007:1.source_cn: 我就算和你们一起回去，应该也帮不上什么忙……

say:11:1120318008:1.text: What if something goes wrong? Having you there would be much more reassuring.
say:11:1120318008:1.source_cn: 万一喝出了什么问题，你在比较保险。

say:12:1120318009:1.text: That's right! You have a responsibility to be there in case he has an adverse reaction to your potion.
say:12:1120318009:1.source_cn: 没错！万一那个小蛮血产生了什么不良反应怎么办！你作为药...

say:13:1120318010:1.text: Hmmm... Very well then, but I'm only doing it for the little boy.
say:13:1120318010:1.source_cn: 这……好吧，看在那只小蛮血的份上，我就再和你们跑一趟吧。

choice:7:0:1.text: We won't know until we try.
choice:7:0:1.male: We won't know until we try.
choice:7:0:1.female: We won't know until we try.

choice:7:1:2.text: Let's just trust him for now.
choice:7:1:2.male: Let's just trust him for now.
choice:7:1:2.female: Let's just trust him for now.

say:3:1120319001:0.text: *Cough* Soren... and Magister... You're all back!
say:3:1120319001:0.source_cn: 咳，咳咳……索恩哥哥，还有魔法师大人……你们回来啦！
say:3:1120319001:0.male: *Cough* Soren... and Magister... You're all back!
say:3:1120319001:0.female: *Cough* Soren... and Magister... You're all back!

say:4:1120319002:0.source_cn: 诶，怎么还多了一只……奇怪的狐獴？

say:5:1120319003:1.text: I am not any "erratic meerkat", little one. My name is Smokey who is a genius apothecary. I'm here to help you.
say:5:1120319003:1.source_cn: 小蛮血，我可不是什么奇怪的狐獴。我是专门来帮你的天才药...

say:7:1120319005:1.text: He's telling the truth, Karun. Here, take this potion.
say:7:1120319005:1.source_cn: 他说的没错。我们弄到药了，你快把这个喝下去试试。

say:9:1120319007:1.text: Trust me, you'll feel much better after you take it.
say:9:1120319007:1.source_cn: 乖，相信我，只要喝下这个，你就能好起来了！

say:10:1120319008:0.source_cn: 咳……好！我听阿尔萨姐姐的话……唔……

say:11:1120319009:0.text: This potion... tastes even worse than the last medicine you gave me.
say:11:1120319009:0.source_cn: 这个药剂……好难喝，比之前的还要难喝，有种怪怪的味道……

say:12:1120319010:0.text: How do you feel now? Any better?
say:12:1120319010:0.source_cn: 你现在感觉怎么样？有哪里不舒服吗？

say:14:1120319012:1.text: Rest assured, the medicine will take effect in just a few minutes. Smokey's potions always work!
say:14:1120319012:1.source_cn: 安心安心，这药剂起效还是需要一点时间的。阿熏出品，绝对精品！

say:3:1120321001:0.text: Hmm... I think I'm starting to feel better, Alsa. And... I'm also really hungry... Can we eat soon?
say:3:1120321001:0.source_cn: 唔……阿尔萨姐姐，我现在好像舒服多了……而且肚子饿了！...

say:4:1120321002:1.text: Oh, thank goodness, your appetite is finally coming back! I'll go make you something to eat right now!
say:4:1120321002:1.source_cn: 太好了，你之前一直都没什么胃口，现在终于想吃东西了！我...

say:5:1120321003:1.text: Looks like the potion did its job after all. He looks much better now.
say:5:1120321003:1.source_cn: 看来那药剂有用，这孩子确实好起来了。

say:8:1120321004:1.text: Like I said, his sickness was easy enough to heal. There was no need to worry the way you did!
say:8:1120321004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，我早就说过了，这种小问题，轻轻松松就能解决的。你...

say:9:1120321005:1.text: Wait, Smokey! I have to ask... What was the "secret ingredient" that you used to make his potion?
say:9:1120321005:1.source_cn: 等等！阿熏，我有个问题想问你……你的那个“祖传秘方”…...

say:10:1120321006:1.text: W-Well, uh... It's called a secret for a reason, you know!
say:10:1120321006:1.source_cn: 这个……我可不太方便说啊。

say:11:1120321007:1.text: It's a family secret that has been passed down for generations... My business would be ruined if people found out, wouldn't you agree?
say:11:1120321007:1.source_cn: 各位应该也明白吧，这种可是我们看家的本事，万一泄露出去...

say:12:1120321008:1.text: We wouldn't tell a soul, trust us!
say:12:1120321008:1.source_cn: 这个你放心，我们肯定不会说出去的！

say:13:1120321009:1.text: I'm just curious... After all, I tried every single one of the herbs on the list, but they only worked after you added your "secret ingredient"...
say:13:1120321009:1.source_cn: 但是我真的很好奇……明明我们都用的同样的草药，为什么只...

say:14:1120321010:1.text: B-But I... Oh, alright! I'll share my little secret with you, but you have to promise not to tell anyone! Ever!
say:14:1120321010:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这……行吧，那我就偷偷告诉各位了，但你们千万不能...

say:15:1120321011:1.text: If anyone were to find out, I'd be in even more trouble than usual!
say:15:1120321011:1.source_cn: 如果其他人知道了，我真的会出问题的！

choice_prompt:16:1120321011.text: If anyone were to find out, I'd be in even more trouble than usual!
choice_prompt:16:1120321011.source_cn: 如果其他人知道了，我真的会出问题的！

say:17:1120321012:1.text: The secret ingredient... is my blood.
say:17:1120321012:1.source_cn: 其实那个祖传配方，就是从我的血液。

say:18:1120321013:1.text: Your... blood? Is your blood really that potent...?
say:18:1120321013:1.source_cn: 是你的……血？你的血竟然这么厉害……？

say:19:1120321014:1.text: Our blood gives we meerkats a natural resistance to poisons, you see.
say:19:1120321014:1.source_cn: 我们狐獴的血液，可以抗毒。

say:21:1120321016:1.text: But if that's the case, doesn't that mean you have to draw your own blood every time you make a potion? That sounds so painful...
say:21:1120321016:1.source_cn: 不过如果是这样的话，你做药剂的时候，岂不是要抽自己的血...

say:22:1120321017:1.text: It's just a little blood, nothing to worry about! Besides, I have plenty of mouths to feed around here...
say:22:1120321017:1.source_cn: 还好还好，一点血而已，毕竟我还要养这么一大家子……

say:23:1120321018:1.text: I mean, I'm more than happy to give out a little blood to help someone! Hahaha!
say:23:1120321018:1.source_cn: 啊不，我的意思是，毕竟我的血可以帮助到其他人嘛，不辛苦...

say:24:1120321019:1.text: It appears the boy's condition is perfectly stable now, so there's no need for another dose of medicine.
say:24:1120321019:1.source_cn: 现在来看，这孩子的情况差不多已经稳定了，之后就不用再服药了。

say:25:1120321020:1.text: Just remember to watch what he eats! Make sure he doesn't eat anything off the ground, or he'll suffer again!
say:25:1120321020:1.source_cn: 但还是要注意饮食！可不能再随便把什么东西都放进嘴里了，...

say:28:1120321021:0.text: No problem! Thank you, Mr. Genius Apothecary Smokey!
say:28:1120321021:0.source_cn: 知道啦！谢谢天才药剂师阿熏先生！

say:29:1120321022:1.text: We really can't thank you enough, Smokey. I don't know what I would've done without your help...
say:29:1120321022:1.source_cn: 这次真的太感谢你了，阿熏。要不是有你，我还真不知道怎么...

say:32:1120321023:1.text: Don't mention it, don't mention it! I'm honored that I could be of help.
say:32:1120321023:1.source_cn: 哎呀，小事小事！能帮到你们也是在下的荣幸啊。

say:33:1120321024:1.text: And now that this little Mauler seems to be recovering, I really should get going.
say:33:1120321024:1.source_cn: 既然这小蛮血病都好的差不多了，我也是时候该回去了。

say:34:1120321025:1.text: Of course! Let me escort you back!
say:34:1120321025:1.source_cn: 当然当然！我送你回去吧！

say:3:1120322001:1.text: Yes, well... There's also... Hmm, you know... that thing? The one you mentioned earlier...?
say:3:1120322001:1.source_cn: 这个……那个……就是那个嘛……那个，各位都知道的……你...

say:4:1120322002:1.text: Oh, I'm sorry! I was so happy that I almost forgot about your payment! What do you want?
say:4:1120322002:1.source_cn: 对不起，我只顾着高兴，忘记了。请说，你需要什么报酬？

say:5:1120322003:1.text: Don't worry, we gave you our word that we would repay you for your help.
say:5:1120322003:1.source_cn: 你放心，承诺给你的报酬，我们不会食言。

say:6:1120322004:1.text: Ah, it's all so embarrassing to bring up...
say:6:1120322004:1.source_cn: 哎呀，这个说来有点不好意思……

say:9:1120322005:1.text: Why's he acting so coy all of a sudden? I have a bad feeling about this meerkat...
say:9:1120322005:1.source_cn: 这只狐獴怎么忽然笑得这么羞涩，让我有种不祥的预感……

say:10:1120322006:1.text: Heehee! Rest assured, everyone! My remuneration is quite affordable for the likes of you!
say:10:1120322006:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，各位放心，我的要求非常朴实无华，各位一定轻松就能...

say:11:1120322007:1.text: All I ask for is enough food to bring back to the children in my clan. Nothing more!
say:11:1120322007:1.source_cn: 我就是想要给部落里的孩子们带点食物回去，仅此而已。

say:12:1120322008:1.text: Is that it? If all you want is food, then leave it to us!
say:12:1120322008:1.source_cn: 原来只是食物啊，没问题，包在我们身上了！

choice_prompt:13:1120322008.text: Is that it? If all you want is food, then leave it to us!
choice_prompt:13:1120322008.source_cn: 原来只是食物啊，没问题，包在我们身上了！

say:14:1120322009:1.text: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—
say:14:1120322009:1.source_cn: 还是这位魔法师大人问得好！我想要的就是对我们狐獴来说，...
say:14:1120322009:1.male: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—
say:14:1120322009:1.female: A wonderful question, my dear mage! What I would like is a meerkat's most sought-after delight—

say:17:1120322012:1.text: I-I-I hardly consider that to be normal food! D-Do you really eat those?!
say:17:1120322012:1.source_cn: 你你你你们竟然吃蜘蛛蛋……这根本就不是“普通的食物”吧！

say:20:1120322013:1.text: Spider eggs... Those are hard to obtain.

say:21:1120322014:1.text: I beg to differ, my friends! If anyone can easily acquire spider eggs, it's your powerful party of adventurers! After all, your first trial...
say:21:1120322014:1.source_cn: 不麻烦不麻烦，如果是你们的话，肯定很轻松就能拿到的！毕...

say:22:1120322015:1.text: Looks like we don't have a choice... I wouldn't have agreed so quickly if I knew this was what you wanted!
say:22:1120322015:1.source_cn: 没办法了……早知道之前不那么轻易答应了！

say:23:1120322016:1.text: Let's just go gather spider eggs for him...

say:24:1120322017:0.text: Excellent! I knew you would keep your word, my friends!
say:24:1120322017:0.source_cn: 好嘞！我就知道几位信守承诺的大人们一定会答应的！

say:25:1120322018:1.text: I'll just stay here and await your triumphant return, yes?
say:25:1120322018:1.source_cn: 那在下就在这里，等候各位满载而归了！

choice:13:0:1.text: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?
choice:13:0:1.male: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?
choice:13:0:1.female: Wait, what exactly do you meerkats eat?

choice:13:1:2.text: Wait, what kind of food do you want?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 等等，你想要带什么食物回去？
choice:13:1:2.male: Wait, what kind of food do you want?
choice:13:1:2.female: Wait, what kind of food do you want?

say:0:1120323001:0.text: I can't believe we got tricked into coming to this awful place again...
say:0:1120323001:0.source_cn: 没想到……又踏足了这可怕的地方！

say:1:1120323002:0.text: We gave him our word, so let's just clear out these spiders.
say:1:1120323002:0.source_cn: 要遵守承诺，把这些蜘蛛解决了吧。

say:0:1120324001:0.text: That should do it. Let's go back and give Smokey his payment.

say:3:1120325001:1.text: My, that was fast! Let me see...
say:3:1120325001:1.source_cn: 竟然这么快就把蜘蛛蛋带回来了。让我看看……

say:4:1120325002:1.text: Yes, these are exactly the ones I wanted! The shape, the color, and that incomparably delicious aroma!
say:4:1120325002:1.source_cn: 没错，我想要的就是这个！这种绝妙的色泽，完美的形状，还...

say:5:1120325003:1.text: Ahh, my mouth is already starting to water!
say:5:1120325003:1.source_cn: 我的口水都要掉下来了！

say:6:1120325004:1.text: Are we... talking about the same spider eggs here?
say:6:1120325004:1.source_cn: 这……难道我们和狐獴们看到的不是同一个蜘蛛蛋吗……

say:7:1120325005:1.text: I may not understand it... But we should respect their tastes all the same.
say:7:1120325005:1.source_cn: 虽然我也不理解……但姑且尊重口味的多样性吧。

say:8:1120325006:1.text: Your generous payment has been received with the utmost gratitude, my friends!
say:8:1120325006:1.source_cn: 好嘞，报酬我已经都收好了。真的太感谢各位了！

say:9:1120325007:1.text: We should be the ones thanking you... You've been such a huge help, Smokey!
say:9:1120325007:1.source_cn: 不不不，应该是我们谢你才对……谢谢你帮了我们！

say:10:1120325008:1.text: Ah, think nothing of it! Feel free to call on me if you ever need my services again!
say:10:1120325008:1.source_cn: 嗨呀，这些都是小事。如果你们下次还有什么要帮忙的，随时...

say:11:1120325009:1.text: Naturally, I will gladly accept spider eggs as compensation!
say:11:1120325009:1.source_cn: 当然，报酬还可以是蜘蛛蛋！

choice_prompt:12:1120325009.text: Naturally, I will gladly accept spider eggs as compensation!
choice_prompt:12:1120325009.source_cn: 当然，报酬还可以是蜘蛛蛋！

say:13:1120325010:1.text: Hahaha! It's getting late, so I must be going now.
say:13:1120325010:1.source_cn: 哈哈，时候不早了，我也差不多该准备离开了。

say:14:1120325011:1.text: That reminds me that you may keep the rest of that potion for yourselves.
say:14:1120325011:1.source_cn: 对了，这瓶药剂，是送给你们的。

say:15:1120325012:1.text: Wait... Isn't this the exact same potion as before?
say:15:1120325012:1.source_cn: 这个是……和之前一样的那种药剂？

say:16:1120325013:1.text: Indeed it is! This potion is useful for treating a variety of basic poisons. You may find use for it later in your travels.
say:16:1120325013:1.source_cn: 嗯，这种药剂可以治疗一些基础的中毒。你们留着以备不时之需吧。

say:17:1120325014:1.text: It must be really valuable. Are you sure you want us to keep it?
say:17:1120325014:1.source_cn: 这个很贵重吧？真的可以送给我们吗？

say:18:1120325015:1.text: You've already done so much for us... It almost feels wrong to accept it after all your help...
say:18:1120325015:1.source_cn: 你帮了我们这么多，还送东西……感觉不太好意思收来着……

say:19:1120325016:1.text: It's fine! Consider it a parting gift!
say:19:1120325016:1.source_cn: 没事，就当是我给你们的送别礼吧。

say:20:1120325017:1.text: However, if you want me to concoct even more unique potions, you'll have to bring me more food. How do scorpions sound to you?
say:20:1120325017:1.source_cn: 不过如果你们还想要更特别的药剂，之后就要用别的东西来换...

say:23:1120325018:1.text: S-S-S-Scorpions?! Do meerkats really eat something that dangerous?!
say:23:1120325018:1.source_cn: 蝎、蝎、蝎子！你们狐獴吃的东西也太奇怪了吧，竟然还吃蝎子！

say:24:1120325019:1.text: They may be dangerous to you, but scorpion venom poses very little threat to us! Their flavorful meat makes them a delicacy on par with spider eggs!
say:24:1120325019:1.source_cn: 对我们狐獴来说，蝎子可一点毒素都没有，反而味道鲜美，就...

choice_prompt:25:1120325019.text: They may be dangerous to you, but scorpion venom poses very little threat to us! Their flavorful meat makes them a delicacy on par with spider eggs!
choice_prompt:25:1120325019.source_cn: 对我们狐獴来说，蝎子可一点毒素都没有，反而味道鲜美，就和蜘蛛蛋一样，是一道美味佳肴哦。

say:26:1120325020:1.text: No kidding! Just thinking about eating this sort of stuff makes me feel sick...
say:26:1120325020:1.source_cn: 没错！光是想象自己要吃这种东西，我就已经不舒服起来了……

say:27:1120325021:1.text: You're welcome to try our cuisine for yourselves someday! I'll even prepare them without poison, just for you!
say:27:1120325021:1.source_cn: 以后有机会的话，你们可以尝尝看，我给你们做个无毒版本的！

say:31:1120325023:1.text: Ah, what a shame! Until next time, my friends!
say:31:1120325023:1.source_cn: 真是可惜！那么我就先走了，各位，有缘再见了！

choice:25:0:1.source_cn: 你们狐獴的菜单还真是丰富……

choice:25:1:2.text: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?
choice:25:1:2.source_cn: 你们狐獴的菜单还真是可怕……
choice:25:1:2.male: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?
choice:25:1:2.female: Are all meerkat foods this terrifying...?

choice:12:0:1.text: I think we're okay for now.
choice:12:0:1.male: I think we're okay for now.
choice:12:0:1.female: I think we're okay for now.

choice:12:1:2.text: I don't want to fight spiders again.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 最近都不想再去打蜘蛛了
choice:12:1:2.male: I don't want to fight spiders again.
choice:12:1:2.female: I don't want to fight spiders again.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.text: Uh-oh, Magister! Looks like we have some obstacles in the area!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.source_cn: 主人小心！这附近有好多障碍物！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.male: Uh-oh, Magister! Looks like we have some obstacles in the area!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.female: Uh-oh, Magister! Looks like we have some obstacles in the area!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308003:.text: Wow... Alsa rolled out so quickly!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308003:.source_cn: 呜哇，阿尔萨……她滚得好快！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308004:.text: This does seem like one of her strong suits, yes.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308004:.source_cn: 阿尔萨在这件事上，非常好用

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308005:.text: ...Alright Smokey, you can stop playing dead now.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308006:.text: A-Ahem... Sorry, I didn't realize it was just you guys.
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308006:.source_cn: 咳咳——我还以为是谁，原来是你们啊

cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.text: Be careful, owner! There are many obstacles around here!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1120308001:.source_cn: 主人小心！这附近有好多障碍物！
